facts.function: measures dew point/humidity and temperature and transmits an electrical signal

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9025 covers hygrometers, psychrometers and thermometers; chapter 90 note 1 exclusions do not apply
GRI 6: 9025.80 other instruments; electrical line 9025.80.10 assumed for an electronic transmitter

rejected_alternatives.reason: non-electrical non-recording hygrometers; R03592 used this for a non-electrical dew point tester, but transmitters are electrical
transmitter here is a measuring instrument, not telecom apparatus

missing_facts: whether the unit is electrical/electronic (assumed) and non-recording
classification.rationale: Dew point measurement indicates moisture content and is covered by heading 9025. R03592 (in force) put a non-electrical dew point tester in 9025.80.35. Electronic transmitters fall in the electrical line 9025.80.10.
